title: Macro and Micronutrient Deficiency Diseases and Their Prevention
shortDescription: Protein-energy malnutrition, vitamin and mineral deficiency diseases with signs and public-health control.
genZNote: Match the nutrient to the disease to the sign — it's a dating app for deficiencies. Night blindness swipes right on vitamin A.

sections.heading: Macronutrient Deficiencies
bullets: Protein–energy malnutrition (PEM): kwashiorkor, marasmus; prevention through breastfeeding, complementary foods, energy-dense and protein-rich diets.
Essential fatty acid deficiency: dry scaly skin, poor growth.
Dietary fibre/excess issues: constipation; excess energy: obesity.

sections.heading: Micronutrient Deficiency Diseases
sections.body: Control approaches: dietary diversification, fortification, supplementation, public-health measures (deworming, sanitation), education and surveillance. Hidden hunger refers to micronutrient deficiency without obvious calorie lack.

table.caption: Deficiency map
rows: Night blindness, Bitot's spots, xerophthalmia, keratomalacia
Prophylaxis, dark green leafy vegetables, orange fruit, fortified oil

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Deficiency diseases arise when macronutrient or micronutrient intake is inadequate; each has characteristic signs and targeted prevention strategies.

highYieldFacts: Zinc is used with ORS in childhood diarrhoea.
commonTraps: Do not match scurvy with vitamin D.
